role: Post-failure interface-contract diagnosis; not a BLER holdout.
prior_result: With num_ul_streams=4, NeuralRx decoded 0/600 over the public -4 to -3 dB grid while conventional decoded 87/600.
hypothesis: The harness confused four gNB receive antennas with one transmitted uplink stream. The public notebook leaves num_ul_streams at its default 1.
only_semantic_change: Set PuschConfig.num_ul_streams=1 for the public one-layer/one-stream profile. Historical synthetic modes retain default 4.
decision_rule: NeuralRx must decode at least one TB and aggregate correct must exceed conventional to open a variable-payload disjoint-seed holdout.
